newsitem.title: SYRIA: Palestinian group PFLP claims attack in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian group PFLP claims attack in West Bank.

text.p: A radical Palestinian guerrilla group on Thursday claimed responsibility for the killing of a Jewish settler and her son in the West Bank and called for more attacks against the Jewish state.

"We confirm our responsibility for the attack which comes within the PFLP's policy of fighting settlers wherever they are," Maher al-Taher, spokesman for the Damascus-based Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine (PFLP), told Reuters.
He said Israel's latest plans to build 132 homes for Jews in the heart of Arab East Jerusalem amounted to a declaration of war against Arabs.

"The building of Jewish housing units in East Jerusalem and the expansion of settlement-building clearly means that Israel is beating the drums of war and preparing for more aggressions against the Palestinian people and the Arab nation," he said.
"The PFLP, while warning the government of (Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin) Netanyahu, affirms that it will confront with all available means the Israeli occupation forces and settlers.
"The PFLP calls on the Palestinian masses inside the occupied homeland and outside it to escalate resistance of all types to burn the Palestinian land under the feet of the invaders."
Since taking office in June, the right-wing Netanyahu government has given the go-ahead for construction of thousands of homes in existing Jewish settlements, enraging Palestinians and Arabs.
Arab gunmen shot dead a 12-year-old Israeli boy and his mother in a drive-by shooting near the PLO-ruled West Bank town of Ramallah on Wednesday.

The PFLP, led by George Habash, is part of a 10-member Palestinian alliance based in Damascus which is opposed to the 1993 peace deal between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organisation. The group has carried out scores of attacks against Israeli troops in southern Lebanon and in Israel.

Earlier on Thursday al-Taher, whose group was initially accused by Israel of carrying out the killings, refused to confirm or deny responsibility but said Palestinians were duty-bound to attack Jewish settlers.
He said the group had "several times warned that settlements and settlers would be military targets that Palestinians have right and duty to attack".
"The Palestinian people have no choice but to confront settlements and occupation with all means," he said.
Taher said Netanyahu's encouragement for settlements showed that he refused to withdraw from occupied Palestinian lands in defiance of the Arab and international communities.
He said military operations by the PFLP, which is influential in the West Bank, would continue against Israel.
"Resistance has not ceased and will never cease until we achieve our people's rights for self-determination and establishment of an independent Palestinian state with Jerusalem as its capital."
